Move your pointer to a screen corner. Or choose Below camera island in Settings so your robot peeks from the notch. It stays hidden while you work.
Drop one or several files onto the robot, or hover and press Control-V or Command-V. Files from one move stay together in one card.
Double-click the robot for Daily, with the newest captures first. Use Daily / Weekly to switch between one day and seven.
Open Settings > Capture and enable Auto Capture. Choose a dedicated screenshot folder when asked. DaBin then saves future copies and new images added there.

Everything stays on your Mac. Pause any time; DaBin and common password managers are excluded by default. At 4 actions in one clock hour, click the summary to expand and use the minus button to collapse.
Filter or search any date. Export Day copies or saves its complete record as UTF-8 text.
Comment, set a reminder, or press + for a task you can mark complete.
Drag the logo to move the board. Settings controls theme, opacity and robot home.

text:
YOUR DAILY COMPANION
A QUICK GUIDE FOR macOS
A little home
for your day.
Keep the links, files, images and ideas you want to come
back to. DaBin saves what you drop or paste into a
personal daily board, right on your Mac.
Text
Links
Files & PDFs
Images & video
START WITH THREE SMALL MOVES
1
Meet your robot
Move your pointer to a screen
corner. Or choose Below
camera island in Settings so
your robot peeks from the notch.
It stays hidden while you work.
2
Drop or paste
Drop one or several files onto
the robot, or hover and press
Control-V or Command-V.
Files from one move stay
together in one card.
3
Open your day
Double-click the robot for Daily,
with the newest captures first.
Use Daily / Weekly to switch
between one day and seven.
AUTO CAPTURE, WHEN YOU WANT IT
OFF BY DEFAULT
Turn it on
Open Settings > Capture and enable Auto Capture.
Choose a dedicated screenshot folder when asked.
DaBin then saves future copies and new images
added there.
Stay in control
Everything stays on your Mac. Pause any time;
DaBin and common password managers are
excluded by default. At 4 actions in one clock hour,
click the summary to expand and use the minus
button to collapse.
Find & export
Filter or search any date. Export Day
copies or saves its complete record as
UTF-8 text.
Add context
Comment, set a reminder, or press +
for a task you can mark complete.
Make it yours
Drag the logo to move the board.
Settings controls theme, opacity and
robot home.
Manual drag and paste always stay available.
